accuracyFlags: 'A Tasmania Parks Pass is required for vehicle entry to national parks and a holiday pass covering all parks for eight weeks': structure correct (Holiday Pass is 8 weeks) but no 2026 price or Parks & Wildlife Service link; 'book the pass in advance in peak season' is unsourced.

Cradle Mountain 'mandatory shuttle bus ... private vehicle access restricted': applies to the Dove Lake road in peak season only, and shuttle is included with park entry; state the season and cite Parks Tasmania.
'Bay of Fires has free and low-cost camping': mostly correct but some sites require booking/fees in summer; verify against Parks Tasmania.
Spirit of Tasmania 'Geelong to Devonport' correct; fares/sailings not dated; quarantine rule on fresh produce correct but unsourced. Total loop '1,400 km' vs heading '10 days' fine.
Section 5 route returns via 'Lake St Clair and the Derwent Valley' while section 3 says 'central highlands or Mount Field': inconsistent.
